@AGENTS.md

<!--
Claude Code 2.1.277 and later reads AGENTS.md only when no CLAUDE.md,
.claude/CLAUDE.md, or CLAUDE.local.md exists in this directory or above it.
This file is present, so
Claude Code reads it instead, and the import on the first line is what loads
the canonical instruction file into a Claude Code session on any version:
https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory#agents-md

A prose "read AGENTS.md" pointer loads nothing at session start; it asks the
agent to open the file, which leaves adherence to whether it does.

Do not duplicate project rules here. Update AGENTS.md instead. Add content
below the import only when it is specific to Claude Code and has no AGENTS.md
counterpart.
-->
